ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 44
   C. 30
   D. 22

2. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 38
   C. 60
   D. 19

4. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 15
   D. 21

5. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19

6. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 2/2
   D. 1/4

7. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x + 2

8. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 64
   C. 9
   D. 8

9. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27
   C. 27.6
   D. 27.7

10. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

11. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 2
   D. 1

12. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

13. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

14. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.7
   C. 31.6
   D. 37

15. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

16. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 4
   C. 8
   D. 5

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
